instruction: I owed people some money. They put the associated expenses on Splitwise yesterday. I paid some of them up on Venmo today. Please record payments on Splitwise for each in their respective groups. Each payment should have a note, "Sent on Venmo, see receipt.", and an attached Venmo receipt of it as a proof.
notes: Three apps (venmo, splitwise, file_system) plus supervisor. The number of Venmo payments made today is only known at runtime; the problem uses two placeholder transactions (txn-1, txn-2), two payees and two groups — the agent instantiates one transaction/payee/group triple per sent transaction returned by venmo.show_transactions(direction=sent, min_created_at=today). Hidden world structure (which transaction went to whom, its amount, the payee's email, which Splitwise group holds yesterday's expense paid by that payee, and the receipt path chosen for each transaction) is stored as static init facts; their use is gated by knowledge predicates asserted by lookup APIs (transactions-listed, groups-listed, group-expenses-known, receipt-downloaded). Receipts are downloaded into the file system via venmo.download_transaction_receipt with file_system_access_token, and splitwise.record_payment is called once per transaction with payer_email = supervisor, receiver_email = Venmo receiver, amount = transaction amount, group_id = the group of yesterday's expense, description = the required note and receipt_file_path + file_system_access_token to attach the receipt (so no separate attach call is needed and no existing files are modified). supervisor-complete-task takes the two transaction records as non-API parameters with an equality constraint so its precondition covers every goal condition; no answer is passed since the task asks no question.
